description: Example inputs for the three QA tools. Each is runnable as documented in README §Commands.

cjkOverflow.note: Exit 1 if any box overflows. P0 = overflows by >10%, P1 = tight 0-10%, P2 = trailing full-width punct on a >90%-full box.

renderQa.note: Static checks always run. Render verification needs soffice + poppler on PATH. P0 findings exit 1.

editableCheck.note: Works without python-pptx (zip-only fallback catches macros, missing theme, flattened slides). Install python-pptx for deep CJK-font coverage.
